sources.excerpt: BAT | Black Arts Toneworks Menu Pedals News Swag Friends & Retailers Contact   BAT BAT BAT A high flying lion or a rodent from the gutter? The newest offering of dirt disease from Black Arts Delicate enough to act as a boost or driver while responding to guitar controls Heavy enough to be a standalone distortion So much gain it can collapse under its own weight or roar like a cutting beast So many eq and texture possibilities it can be an always “on” device. BAT Features: Three Input voicings all with different bass response Pre Gain to drive the Baxandall Style Tone controls Led or Silicon Clipping Hi Cut before the 2nd gain stage Hi Drive for Top end detail and drive Lo Drive for low end drive Gain and Volume controls 9v negative center power requirement ( Power Supply not included) True Bypass switching $199.00 Powered by © 2026 Black Arts Toneworks.
